description: This Java source file defines an immutable implementation of the Adaptable interface, representing an adaptable data structure with topic path, payload, and headers attributes, providing methods for creation, access, and equality comparison.

classes.name: ImmutableAdaptable
classes.description: An immutable class implementing Adaptable, encapsulating topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableAdaptable instance with specified topic path, payload, and optional headers.

methods.name: getHeaders

methods.name: containsHeaderForKey
methods.description: Checks if headers contain a specific key.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns headers, or empty headers if null.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
